story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain, from code (not observed): on an overhead plan of a generic Houston operating room, the four corner cameras power up. At wall height their lamps light in turn, and on the plan an attendant pushes a gurney along the corridor. Camera pulses stamp Patient entry on the plan clock as the gurney crosses the door. They stamp Draped on a steel wall record panel as two attendants lay the drape below it, and Turnover on the plan as the draped patient leaves and a sheet is laid. A desk phone lights as the next patient is wheeled in, slid across and draped, and the text arrives. The study records play on a desk ledger, ending on a blank turnover box beside a clock with a 25-case result card, then a cut to the room with its lamps lit and the same answer legible on the ledger.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on the plan with the cameras powering up and answers at s7. It closes on the detail box and result card, then on the room behind the ledger, where the same answer is now unsquashed. The causal arc holds, and the final picture can carry the answer on its own, subject to phone legibility.
